constraints.constraint_definition: CHECK (decision_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['OFFER_APPROVED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying, 'DEFERRED'::character varying, 'WAITLISTED'::character varying]::text[]))

CHECK (enrolment_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'STUDENT_CREATED'::character varying, 'ENROLMENT_COMPLETED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying]::text[]))

CHECK (admitted_count >= 0)

PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)

FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, application_id) REFERENCES stu.applications(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, application_id) REFERENCES stu.applications(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)

CHECK (recommendation::text = ANY (ARRAY['RECOMMEND_OFFER'::character varying, 'RECOMMEND_REJECT'::character varying, 'WAITLIST'::character varying, 'REQUEST_INFORMATION'::character varying]::text[]))
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES core.tenants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, application_id) REFERENCES stu.applications(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES core.tenants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, application_id) REFERENCES stu.applications(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)

CHECK (document_verification_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying, 'VERIFIED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying, 'WAIVED'::character varying]::text[]))
CHECK (payment_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'PAID'::character varying, 'WAIVED'::character varying, 'EXEMPT'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying]::text[]))

CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'SUBMITTED'::character varying, 'RETURNED_FOR_INFORMATION'::character varying, 'ELIGIBLE'::character varying, 'UNDER_REVIEW'::character varying, 'OFFERED'::character varying, 'ACCEPTED'::character varying, 'DECLINED'::character varying, 'EXPIRED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying, 'WITHDRAWN'::character varying, 'HANDOVER_PENDING'::character varying, 'HANDED_OVER'::character varying]::text[]))
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES core.tenants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, intake_id, application_number)

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX ix_admission_decisions_app ON stu.admission_decisions USING btree (tenant_id, application_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pk_admission_decisions ON stu.admission_decisions USING btree (tenant_id, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_admission_eligibility_intake ON stu.admission_eligibility_rules USING btree (tenant_id, intake_id, is_active)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pk_admission_eligibility_rules ON stu.admission_eligibility_rules USING btree (tenant_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_eligibility_rules_version ON stu.admission_eligibility_rules USING btree (tenant_id, intake_id, version)

CREATE INDEX ix_admission_handovers_status ON stu.admission_handovers USING btree (tenant_id, enrolment_status) WHERE ((enrolment_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying])::text[]))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pk_admission_handovers ON stu.admission_handovers USING btree (tenant_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_admission_handovers_idempotency ON stu.admission_handovers USING btree (tenant_id, idempotency_key)
CREATE INDEX ix_admission_intakes_tenant_prog_year ON stu.admission_intakes USING btree (tenant_id, program_id, academic_year_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_admission_intakes_window ON stu.admission_intakes USING btree (tenant_id, application_window_start, application_window_end) WHERE ((is_active = true) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pk_admission_intakes ON stu.admission_intakes USING btree (tenant_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_admission_intakes_code ON stu.admission_intakes USING btree (tenant_id, academic_year_id, intake_code)
CREATE INDEX ix_admission_offers_app ON stu.admission_offers USING btree (tenant_id, application_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_admission_offers_expiry ON stu.admission_offers USING btree (tenant_id, status, valid_to) WHERE ((status)::text = 'ISSUED'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pk_admission_offers ON stu.admission_offers USING btree (tenant_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_admission_offers_code ON stu.admission_offers USING btree (tenant_id, offer_code)
CREATE INDEX ix_app_documents_app ON stu.application_documents USING btree (tenant_id, application_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_app_documents_doc ON stu.application_documents USING btree (tenant_id, document_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pk_application_documents ON stu.application_documents USING btree (tenant_id, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_app_reviews_app ON stu.application_reviews USING btree (tenant_id, application_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_app_reviews_reviewer ON stu.application_reviews USING btree (tenant_id, reviewer_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pk_application_reviews ON stu.application_reviews USING btree (tenant_id, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_app_status_history_app ON stu.application_status_history USING btree (tenant_id, application_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pk_application_status_history ON stu.application_status_history USING btree (tenant_id, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_applications_dept ON stu.applications USING btree (tenant_id, assigned_department_id) WHERE (assigned_department_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX ix_applications_reviewer ON stu.applications USING btree (tenant_id, assigned_reviewer_id) WHERE (assigned_reviewer_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX ix_applications_tenant_applicant ON stu.applications USING btree (tenant_id, applicant_person_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_applications_tenant_status ON stu.applications USING btree (tenant_id, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pk_applications ON stu.applications USING btree (tenant_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_applications_number ON stu.applications USING btree (tenant_id, intake_id, application_number)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_applications_prevent_duplicates ON stu.applications USING btree (tenant_id, intake_id, applicant_person_id) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND ((status)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['WITHDRAWN'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying])::text[])))
